calibration.note: Forbidden 'glitch zone' = low saturation + high value (washed-out near-white). Owned by the /calibrate tool; do not hand-edit as the source of truth. sMin/vMax are a pre-calibration estimate of the blue-box region; run /calibrate to pin them to the real fixture boundary, then `npm run build:shaders` and re-import the .frag into ELM.
